title: finance.orders.invoice.issued
description: Finance raised an invoice in answer to `operations.orders.order.invoice_requested` (Fulfilment ADR-0024 §1/§4): the recomputed tax matched the requester's price snapshot exactly. Deliberately narrow — operations does not need finance's GST-shaped fields to know its order is billed — and a different topic from `finance.billing.invoice.issued` (emitted by `create_invoice`, the general-purpose invoice-creation path): the two are not the same event, and a consumer of one must not assume it also receives the other.
